title: Registry Return Fees for Mailed and Collected Gifts — Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry
content:
**Schedule of registry return fees, Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry.** The registry return fee on a registry gift the registrant has returned follows the return record kept with Merchandise Purchases — its return method and its return reason — together with the registrant's tier in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program. The fee is deducted from the registry credit for the gift, and the credit never goes below zero.

- A return by mail with a prepaid label, when the registrant has no active Finch Circle membership or the tier that membership holds when the credit is booked does not include free return shipping, and the return reason is not a fee-waiver reason, carries the registry label fee of **USD 9.95**.
- A return by carrier pickup whose return reason is not a fee-waiver reason carries the registry pickup fee of **USD 99.00**.
- Otherwise no registry return fee is charged.

The fee-waiver reasons are defective, damaged in transit and not as described.

### Fee table

| Return method | Active Finch Circle tier, when the credit is booked, includes free return shipping | Fee-waiver reason | Registry return fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| mail, prepaid label | no (or no active membership) | no | USD 9.95 |
| mail, prepaid label | yes | no | none |
| mail, prepaid label | any | yes | none |
| carrier pickup | any | no | USD 99.00 |
| carrier pickup | any | yes | none |
| any other method | any | any | none |

### Cases (hypothetical)

- A registrant mails back a duplicate toaster with a prepaid label, for a reason that is not a fee-waiver reason, and holds no active Finch Circle membership: USD 9.95.
- A registrant has a sofa collected by carrier pickup because it arrived not as described: no fee.
